evals.prompt: $product:ask。这是空文件夹，我要开始做一个需求。
evals.expected_output: Tells the user to run $product:init. Does not itself run the full workflow.
assertions: Does not start $product:workflow in this turn.

evals.expected_output: Because ask and workflow are user-invoked, a generic 'do the requirement' does not enter $product:workflow. Ask lists candidates; workflow only runs when named.
assertions: Does not treat the prompt as authorization to run $product:workflow.
If answering via ask, lists $product:workflow as something the user must name.
Does not write a full-slice stage sequence as if through-run already started.
